title: Driving modes and app-based parking steps
summary: This topic mixes comments about mostly aesthetic vehicle modes with a parking function that requires additional app interaction and may be most useful in complicated parking scenarios.

negative.summary: The negative feedback says the parking function seems mainly beneficial in complicated parking situations rather than broadly useful.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments describe extra modes as mainly changing styling or cabin ambience and note that app-based parking requires pressing and holding a blue circle to complete the process.

limitations: The sample is very small and most fragments are undetermined, so sentiment conclusions are limited.
This cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including aesthetic mode adjustments and parking-process steps, rather than one clearly coherent issue.
Examples are insufficient to assess broader customer satisfaction with these features.
